method.evidence_tree: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
method.scope_respected: Only the exported data/ tree and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff and git history were not read. The scenario definition itself lives outside the permitted scope, so the computation below is a source-anchored identification of the factor that separates the two values, not a re-run of the scenario.
method.note: No file under data/ or docs/math-foundations.md contains the scenario name, the string 'pair_damage', or either numeric value (grep-verified), so no part of this analysis is contaminated by the change under test.

step_1_ratio.reading: The two values differ by a single multiplicative factor of 1.12 to four significant figures.

step_2_rounding_closure.reading: The pair (166.8, 186.8) is exactly the one-decimal image of a single x1.12 relation. Absolute delta is 20.0, and 166.8 x 0.12 = 20.016, consistent with the same factor.

candidate_factors_in_the_named_items.Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' curse: x1.12 on magic damage  -- MATCHES the observed ratio exactly and parameter-free
candidate_factors_in_the_named_items.Imperial Mandate 'Command' Vulnerable: x1.07 on all damage -- 166.8 x 1.07 = 178.48, does not match

step_3_attribution.cache_uniqueness_check: Scanned every passive/active branch text in data/items.json for damage-increase language. Abyssal Mask is the only item in the cache granting a flat 12% damage amplification; the 1.12 factor is uniquely attributable to Unmake.

rejected_alternative.hypothesis: Bloodletter's Curse 'Vile Decay' 4-stack 30% magic-resist reduction toggling on this event
rejected_alternative.test: A 30% MR shred produces a damage ratio (100+R)/(100+0.7R). Setting that equal to 1.11990 requires the target's magic resist to be exactly R = 55.49.
rejected_alternative.why_rejected: It reproduces the observed ratio only for one finely fitted resistance value, whereas the Unmake explanation reproduces it exactly for every resistance. Parsimony favours the amplifier. Note that this alternative points the same direction: it too is a damage-increasing effect present in the old value and absent in the new.

sourced_gates_on_Unmake: radius gate: applies only to 'Enemy champions within 700 units (center to edge) of you'
damage-type gate: grants '12% increased magic damage', not increased damage from all sources
uniqueness gate: the passive is flagged unique: true in the cache, so two roster members carrying Abyssal Mask must not stack the curse
step_4_direction.contrast: Imperial Mandate's Command is deliberately worded 'increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%' -- no damage-type restriction. The two items are written to differ on exactly this point, so a scenario named for both amps plus a roster is a test of amp scoping.
step_4_direction.asymmetry_argument: All three sourced gates on Unmake can only subtract the x1.12 factor relative to a naive always-on implementation. No rule in the cached wiki text can introduce an extra x1.12 on a pair that does not already qualify. In a roster scenario the golden must therefore contain both cursed and uncursed (attacker, target) pairs, and the failure mode the sources warn against is over-application, not under-application. The change removes exactly one curse factor from one event, which is the shape of a scoping fix (non-magic damage packet, out-of-radius target, or a non-stacking second holder), not the shape of a regression.
step_4_direction.conclusion: 166.8 = the pair damage with the Unmake curse correctly absent; 186.8 = the same packet with one spurious x1.12 curse amplification applied.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition and the golden event stream are outside the permitted evidence tree, so the damage type, target and holder of events[12] could not be observed. The identification of the differing factor as one Abyssal Mask Unmake curse is established arithmetically and is not in doubt. The direction rests on the argument that every sourced gate on that curse can only remove it, so the value without the extra amplification is the one the sources support. If the scenario's events[12] is in fact magic damage delivered to a target inside 700 units of a single Abyssal Mask holder, then the old value would be the correct one; nothing readable inside the permitted scope indicates that, and a roster scenario exists precisely to exercise the pairs where the curse must not apply.
